verdict_criteria: arrival exact where the core models it (SpO2, MAP, PaCO2; L = 0 is the arrival congestion; L_rev 0)
family writer writes L only and owns it (no SpO2, G, DO2, RR or lactate scripting)
L worsening -> G worsening -> SpO2 worsening (every progression rate)
oxygen through the common FiO2 path (monotone, attenuated by the common r, no family function)
decongestion back to arrival improves G and SpO2, none below arrival (L_rev 0), V and P unchanged
authority: no double writing; common overload without the family; second owner refused
GI and ACS unchanged; no common file changed
design.verdict_rule: Predeclared. E if the case truth is insufficient; D if the authority, the GI / ACS non-regression or the proof (P2O-3's tree, digest and record reproduced, common files untouched) fails; C if the arrival, the writer, the L -> G -> SpO2 direction, oxygen, decongestion or the HR sign fails; otherwise B when an expected respiratory extension is required (authored RR above the common arrival RR by more than RR_GAP, or a definitive action needing a deferred common extension), else A. Every criterion decides a letter. The verdict covers the case it ran: acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema without volume overload (the other variant is not tested)
